description: List the published Mzizi agent skills, or fetch one in full. Skills are what an agent loads first. Each skill has a category: `dev` (how every agent works in every repo: digital-hygiene and progress-report — load these before any dev work), `design`, `language` or `build`. Pass `category` to get every skill in it in full (e.g. category=dev), or `name` for one skill. Served from the skill files bundled into this server at build time, so they are exactly the text in mzizi-dev/agent-tools at the deployed commit.

category.description: Return every skill in this category in full: dev (digital-hygiene, progress-report — for every agent in every repo), design, language or build.

name.description: Skill name. Omit to list all.

name: mzizi_get_skills
title: Get agent skills
